svg.title: Atlantic North Equatorial Undercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 1300 km. Declared western-to-central Atlantic subsurface reference reach between observations at 35 W near 5 N and the central observational neighborhood at 23 W near 5 N. Connecting vertices are editorial, not an observed continuous axis. Excludes NBC/NEC source recirculation, surface NECC flow, uncertain filaments east of 28 W and farther-east termination. Not full-current source-to-end length. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 35 W–23 W subsurface reference reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Bourles et al. (1999); Burmeister et al. (2020); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
